name: Maid Marian

crownPassive.name: Lady of the greenwood
crownPassive.text: In rounds when you hold the Fate token, all enemy attacks deal half damage, rounded up.

bond.text: The first time another of your Albion heroes dies, she gains +2 Attack and +1 Speed for the rest of the fight.
bond.name: Avenge the greenwood

actions.name: Attack
actions.text: Standard attack: damage equal to Attack.

actions.name: Fair fight
actions.text: Attack an enemy hero for 4. If she acts before it this round, it also loses its action.

rules: Halving applies after every bonus. Removal effects are not damage, so it doesn't stop them.
